insights.headline: Gold slips after strong US payrolls lift the dollar; Dhanteras trade hits a record
insights.summary: Spot gold fell toward $4,050 after US October payrolls beat forecasts by a wide margin, lifting the dollar and December Fed hike bets. MCX gold eased about Rs 2,300 per 10 g on Dhanteras even as festive trade hit a record Rs 1.25 lakh crore, and the rupee strengthened to 93.91 per dollar.
points: US October payrolls rose 165,000, more than double the 65,000 forecast, and unemployment eased to 4.1%, lifting the dollar and December Fed hike bets.
Spot gold fell toward $4,050, down about 1.2% on the day, after touching a two-week high of $4,146 on Thursday; it stayed up about 4% on the week.
MCX December gold fell about Rs 2,300 per 10 g to Rs 1,41,808 and silver about Rs 3,440 per kg to Rs 1,83,700 on Dhanteras.
Dhanteras trade hit a record Rs 1.25 lakh crore, with gold and silver sales over Rs 66,000 crore, CAIT said.
The rupee strengthened to 93.91 per dollar, its strongest since April, and forex reserves fell to $717.05 billion.

brief.headline: Gold slips after strong US payrolls lift dollar
brief.summary: MCX gold fell Rs 2,300 per 10 g and silver Rs 3,440 per kg as spot gold eased to $4,050 after payrolls beat forecasts.

bullets.text: US payrolls rose 165,000 in October, far above the 65,000 forecast, lifting the dollar and keeping December Fed hike bets alive.
Dhanteras trade hit a record Rs 1.25 lakh crore as buyers crowded Zaveri Bazaar, while the rupee's rise to 93.91 eases import costs.
Watch US October CPI on Tuesday, 10 November at 7 PM IST, the next test of December Fed hike bets.

trending.title: Dhanteras dip, festive demand stirs
trending.summary: MCX gold and silver slipped on Dhanteras, but Dhanteras trade hit a record Rs 1.25 lakh crore and Zaveri Bazaar buyers crowded in as prices cooled from record highs.

trending.title: Payrolls beat keeps Fed hike bets alive
trending.summary: October payrolls came in at 165,000, more than double the forecast, lifting the dollar and pulling gold toward $4,050; December hike bets stay in focus.

trending.title: Rupee at 93.91 as reserves slide
trending.summary: The rupee closed at 93.91 per dollar, its strongest since April, on falling crude and foreign inflows, while forex reserves fell to $717.05 billion as the RBI sold dollars.

trending.title: Silver slips with gold, but the case builds
trending.summary: Silver fell harder than gold on Dhanteras, yet analysts say the metal's bullish breakout case is building as bond yields retreat, and its ETF is drawing festive attention.

trending.title: WGC: correction, not a downturn
trending.summary: The World Gold Council says October's 6.3% fall may mark an interim bottom, with the macro backdrop far stronger than after gold's 2011 peak.

items.title: Gold falls toward $4,050 as strong US NFP keeps Fed hawks in control
items.summary: Spot gold fell toward $4,050, down about 1.2% on the day, after US October payrolls came in at 165,000 — more than double the 65,000 forecast — with unemployment easing to 4.1%. The strong jobs data lifted the dollar and Treasury yields and strengthened the case for a December Fed rate hike, pulling gold off Thursday's two-week high of $4,146. Bullion still held on to a weekly gain of about 4%.

items.title: MCX gold prices dip Rs 2,400/10g; silver falls Rs 3,400/kg on Dhanteras as rate hike bets rise again
items.summary: MCX December gold fell about Rs 2,300 per 10 g to Rs 1,41,808 and silver about Rs 3,440 per kg to Rs 1,83,700 on Dhanteras, the Economic Times reports, as a firmer dollar and rising December Fed hike bets — now priced at 71% — pulled spot gold down 0.4% to $4,040 an ounce and silver 1.5% to $51.42. Goldman Sachs cut its end-2026 gold forecast to $4,150 an ounce.

items.title: Gold eases on inflation worries from higher oil; US payrolls data in focus
items.summary: Spot gold fell 1.1% to $4,044 an ounce as rebounding oil fanned inflation worries and higher-for-longer rate expectations, though bullion stayed up 3.5% on the week, its best since late August. US gold futures fell 1.5% to $4,053. Traders put a 68% chance on a December Fed hike, and Goldman Sachs cut its end-2026 gold forecast to $4,150. Markets await the US October payrolls report at 7 PM IST.

items.title: India's Dhanteras business hits record Rs 1.25 lakh crore: CAIT
items.summary: Dhanteras generated a record Rs 1.25 lakh crore in business across India, CAIT said, with gold and silver sales crossing Rs 66,000 crore — about 53% of the total — according to the All India Jewellers and Goldsmith Federation. Delhi's bullion market contributed over Rs 10,000 crore, with demand strong for lightweight jewellery, silver coins and investment-led purchases despite record-high prices.

items.title: Gold Rush On Dhanteras! Zaveri Bazaar Buyers Defy PM's Appeal Amid Record Prices
items.summary: Despite record-high gold prices, buyers crowded Mumbai's Zaveri Bazaar on Dhanteras, Business Today reports, with footfall up, shoppers arriving earlier than usual and advance bookings rising. IBJA spokesperson Kumar Jain said buying sentiment stayed strong across jewellery, coins and ritual gold, even amid the Prime Minister's appeal to curb gold purchases.

items.title: Rupee hits six-month high of 93.91 against dollar on oil price decline
items.summary: The rupee gained 0.6% to close at 93.91 per dollar, its strongest since 22 April and a sixth straight daily gain, as falling crude oil prices and foreign inflows into equities lifted the currency. Brent crude eased to $96.84 a barrel. India's forex reserves fell to $717.06 billion in the week ended October 30.

items.title: India's forex reserves fall by $2.69 billion to $717.05 billion as RBI steps in to defend rupee
items.summary: India's forex reserves fell $2.69 billion to $717.05 billion in the week ended October 30, RBI data showed, as the central bank sold dollars to defend the rupee. Foreign currency assets fell $2.09 billion to $591.12 billion, while the value of gold reserves declined $559 million to $102.59 billion. Reserves have fallen from a record $785.71 billion in early September.

items.title: Gold hits a two-week high as dollar, Treasury yields ease after US midterm elections
items.summary: Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83 an ounce on Thursday, its highest since October 22, as a weaker dollar and lower Treasury yields followed the Democrats' midterm sweep, Reuters reports. December futures rose 1.8% to $4,144.20 and spot silver rose 1.7% to $53.12. Traders await Friday's payrolls, pricing an 82% chance of a December Fed rise, per CME FedWatch.

items.title: Electronic Gold Receipts cross 1 lakh units in single-day trade on NSE on Dhanteras
items.summary: Electronic Gold Receipts crossed 1 lakh units in a single day's trade on the NSE on Dhanteras, ANI reports, a record day for the exchange-traded gold segment launched in May. EGRs let investors hold dematerialised gold backed by physical metal in SEBI-accredited vaults, and NSE has been pushing the product as a digital alternative to physical buying.

items.title: Gold price outlook: World Gold Council sees signs of an interim bottom
items.summary: The World Gold Council says gold may be nearing an interim bottom after a 6.3% October fall to $3,913, with two of three recovery conditions — technical dislocation and dollar strength — in place. Speculative positions have yet to wash out. The Council sees a correction as more likely than a prolonged post-2011-style downturn, citing restrictive real yields, a strong dollar and geopolitical risk.

items.title: Gold holds gains, silver slips as Wall Street plunges, Fed hike bets ease - Kitco PM Report
items.summary: Spot gold held near $4,087 an ounce in late US trading on Thursday, up 0.6%, after touching $4,148 intraday, as a tech-led Wall Street selloff pushed Treasury yields lower and cut December Fed hike bets to about 66-69% from 83%. Spot silver slipped 0.8% to about $51.78 as industrial-demand worries weighed. Attention turns to Friday's October US payrolls report.

items.title: Gold gets its festive groove back in India as prices cool from record highs
items.summary: India's gold jewellery demand is picking up this quarter, Crisil Ratings says, with footfalls rising as gold cools from record highs. Demand was hit by the import duty rising to 15% in May and record retail prices, and the World Gold Council expects India's gold imports to fall to a six-year low. Buyers favour smaller purchases such as coins and bars and lighter, lower-karat jewellery.

items.title: Silver ETF Dhanteras 2026: Nippon India Silver ETF SILVERBEES — 145% returns in 3 years! Should you buy? Experts' views
items.summary: Nippon India Silver ETF (SILVERBEES) has risen more than 145% over three years, about 37% annualised, Livemint reports, with a net asset value of Rs 174.80. SEBI-registered expert Anuj Gupta expects silver to reach Rs 3 lakh per kg in India during Samvat 2083, citing the US midterm elections and low interest rates.

items.title: Cheaper Gold Brought Asian Jewelry Buyers Back
items.summary: Cheaper gold drew shoppers back to jewellery counters across Asia this week, Finimize reports: Indian buyers stocked up ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali as spot slipped below $4,000 an ounce, while Chinese demand ticked up. Indian dealer premiums eased to about $4 an ounce over official domestic prices, down from up to $7, suggesting supply is meeting the extra demand.

items.title: Dhanteras 2026: CAIT expects ₹1 lakh crore in gold & silver sales, AIJGF projects 10% YoY increase
items.summary: Traders' body CAIT expects Dhanteras gold and silver sales to cross Rs 1 lakh crore across India, Business Today reports, with the All India Gem and Jewellery Federation projecting a 10% year-on-year rise as buyers shift to smaller, value-optimised pieces rather than cutting back entirely.

items.title: Gold Outlook: Can Prices Hold $4,044 as Trump Weighs His Next Move on Iran?
items.summary: Gold futures hovered near $4,054 after testing a day's low of $4,045, with $4,044 the immediate support to watch, as traders weighed President Trump's next move on Iran after the US midterm elections. Investing.com's Satendra Singh writes gold could stay under near-term pressure, with a negotiated deal looking more likely than a full-scale assault.

items.title: Gold and Silver Forecast: Recovery Stalls Ahead of US Jobs Data
items.summary: FXEmpire's technical read says gold's recovery has stalled at $4,150 resistance and silver needs to clear $55 to extend its rebound, with traders pricing a 68% chance of a December Fed hike; weak hiring and slow wage growth in Friday's US jobs data could ease hike fears and support both metals.

items.title: Silver’s 2027 Surplus Forecast Puts the Bullish Case for ETF Demand to the Test
items.summary: Metals Focus now expects a 37.3-million-ounce silver surplus in 2027, against a 35.4-million-ounce shortfall in 2026, as solar-panel makers use less silver; even so, it forecasts an average silver price of $72.60 this year and $84.40 in 2027, resting the case on inflows into physical silver ETFs.

items.title: Why the silver price case now rests on investors
items.summary: Metals Focus, which compiles the World Silver Survey, now expects silver to swing to a 37.3-million-ounce surplus in 2027, from a 35.4-million-ounce deficit this year, as solar-panel makers use less silver per panel. It still sees a higher average price next year, but says the case rests on buying by silver funds, not a shortage, and silver should keep lagging gold near-term.

Silver is testing downtrend resistance from late-September highs after reclaiming $51.27 and $52.67, with gold's breakout from its own September downtrend lighting the way, FOREX.com's technical analysis says. The metals' 10-day correlation is +0.99 with silver's beta near 1.7, so a confirmed breakout could target $54.78-$58.50; $51.27-$52.67 must hold, with $48.86 the key support below.
items.title: Silver's bullish breakout case builds as bond yields retreat
Gold ETFs performance on Dhanteras 2026 today 6 Nov 2026: Check how Nippon India, Tata Gold, ICICI Prudential fared
items.summary: Gold ETFs fell on Dhanteras, down 1.5–2.3% over five days as gold cooled from record highs, Livemint reports. Nippon India Gold ETF fell 1.94% in five days, ICICI Prudential Gold ETF 1.97% and Tata Gold ETF 1.85%, while all three remain up roughly 67–69% over one year.

items.title: Gold Rush This Dhanteras! World Gold Council On Prices, Demand & Jewellery Trends
items.summary: World Gold Council India chief Sachin Jain told Times Now that buyers stayed buoyant through the recent price correction and he expects a strong Diwali buying platform, with lightweight daily-wear jewellery and old-gold exchange the key trends as shoppers favour smaller purchases.

items.title: Gold vs silver this Dhanteras: Price outlook, buying trends and key risks
items.summary: CNBC-TV18 weighs gold against silver for Dhanteras buyers: gold is about 20% below its January peak and silver roughly 50% below, after silver's much sharper October correction. The piece notes silver's higher volatility and industrial demand, and that lower prices are drawing festive buyers toward lighter gold pieces and silver jewellery.

items.title: Buying gold this Dhanteras? Don’t pay before checking these 6 things
items.summary: CNBC-TV18 lists six checks for Dhanteras gold buyers: verify the BIS logo, purity mark and six-digit HUID on hallmarked jewellery, confirm the HUID on the BIS Care app, and have pieces weighed in front of you. Buyers should also insist on a detailed GST invoice and know that BIS can award twice the value difference plus testing charges if hallmarked purity falls short.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Turns Down Its Gold Targets After A Hawkish Fed
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its end-2026 gold target to $4,150 an ounce from $4,650 and its end-2027 target to $4,800 from $5,400, saying a hawkish Federal Reserve and rates staying higher for longer make holding non-yielding gold less attractive. The bank still sees support from central-bank buying and long-term investors holding bullion as insurance against government debt and budget risks.

items.title: Fed's Hammack Repeats Call for Small Rate Increases to Curb Inflation
items.summary: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack repeated her call for smaller, more frequent rate increases to bring inflation back to 2%, saying policy still needs to tighten; she was one of two officials who dissented in favour of a hike when the Fed held rates last week, and markets price an 83% chance of a December increase, according to CME FedWatch.

items.title: Poland central bank chief leaves door open to more gold buying after hitting 700-ton target
items.summary: Poland's central bank has reached its 700-tonne gold reserve target and Governor Adam Glapinski said he sees no reason to stop buying, with holdings now worth 356 billion zlotys ($91.4 billion). Poland is the world's 10th-largest gold holder and the biggest reported central-bank buyer of 2024-2026, according to World Gold Council data.

items.title: Dhanteras Gold Buyers Turn To Informal Channels As Import Duty Fuels Smuggling
items.summary: A LocalCircles survey found 29% of planned Dhanteras gold buyers may use informal channels, as the 15% import duty plus GST lifts the total levy to about 18.45%. The World Gold Council put unofficial inflows at about 50 tonnes in July-September, up from about 3 tonnes a year earlier.

items.title: BIS Hallmarking System Strengthens Consumer Trust, Over 65 Crore Gold Articles Get HUID
items.summary: More than 65 crore gold articles have been hallmarked with a unique HUID since mandatory hallmarking began, the Bureau of Indian Standards said, as buyers check purity ahead of Dhanteras.

items.title: Dhanteras 2026: Buying gold or silver? Know how jewellery, coins, ETFs and SGBs are taxed
items.summary: Tax on gold and silver depends on the form bought, Moneycontrol explains: long-term capital gains are taxed at 12.5% without indexation and short-term gains at the buyer's income-tax slab rate, with different treatment for physical metal, digital gold, ETFs, mutual funds and Sovereign Gold Bonds; inherited or gifted gold is not taxed on receipt.
